description.value: A preliminary pharmacogenetic fMRI study examining whether 5-HTTLPR allele loading moderates escitalopram-related changes in emotion-regulation functional connectivity between the left amygdala and right IFG in healthy women.

spans.text: In this preliminary study, we explore the moderating effect of 5-HTTLPR on the impact of the SSRI, escitalopram during emotion regulation of negative emotional stimuli.

value: we predicted a linear relationship (dose–response) between 5-HTTLPR and L amygdala-R IFG functional connectivity during the reappraisal of negative images after single dose escitalopram relative to placebo.
we hypothesize that ‘S/S’ allele carriers will display more positive L amygdala-R IFG coupling than ‘L/L’ homozygotes during reappraisal of negative stimuli under escitalopram.

description.value: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover study with two fMRI sessions separated by a seven-day washout period.
